verdict.rationale: Fetching TOTP codes programmatically is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows codes are only viewed and entered manually in the mobile app, with no documented CLI or API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. The Screen Capture setting and the community tip to copy the TOTP secret into a password manager are an adjacent control and a user-side workaround, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
